talent.imsotalented.faster_mining.desc: Mine faster with the right tool, like the Efficiency enchantment. Gear keeps its own Efficiency if that's higher.
talent.imsotalented.gatherer_xp.desc: Earn Gatherer XP faster from mining, chopping, farming and fishing.
talent.imsotalented.reach.desc: Mine and use blocks from further away, and reach mobs a little further.
talent.imsotalented.careful_hands.desc: Your gear wears out more slowly, like the Unbreaking enchantment. Gear keeps its own Unbreaking if that's higher.
talent.imsotalented.careful_hands.effect: Gear works as if it had Unbreaking %s
talent.imsotalented.bountiful_harvest.de: Mature crops drop more of what you grow.
talent.imsotalented.backpack.desc: Unlocks rows of your backpack, up to a second full inventory. Open it with Shift and your inventory key. Items that don't fit your inventory go there.
talent.imsotalented.more_luck.desc: More drops from blocks, mobs and fishing, like Fortune, Looting and Luck of the Sea. Gear keeps its own level if that's higher.
talent.imsotalented.more_luck.effect: Fortune, Looting and Luck of the Sea %s
talent.imsotalented.stronger_weapons.des: More damage with every attack. Unlocks the weapon specialists, and Lifesteal at level 5.
talent.imsotalented.warrior_xp.desc: Earn Warrior XP faster from the damage you deal to hostile mobs.
talent.imsotalented.unarmed_specialist.d: Harder punches with an empty hand.
talent.imsotalented.spear_specialist.des: More damage with spears, jabs and charges.
talent.imsotalented.mace_specialist.desc: More damage with maces, smash attacks included.
talent.imsotalented.bow_specialist.desc: More damage with arrows from bows and crossbows.
talent.imsotalented.trident_specialist.d: More damage with tridents, thrown or in hand.
talent.imsotalented.lifesteal.desc: Your attacks heal you for part of the damage you deal. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.lifesteal.effect: Heals for %s%% of the damage you deal
talent.imsotalented.guardian_xp.desc: Earn Guardian XP faster from the hits hostile mobs aim at you.
talent.imsotalented.stronger_armor.desc: Your armor and armor toughness count for more.
talent.imsotalented.shield_mastery.desc: Your shield blocks sooner after you raise it, and an axe disables it for less time.
talent.imsotalented.fire_resistance.desc: When you catch fire, you gain fire resistance for a while. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.fire_resistance.effe: Fire resistance for %s seconds, at most every %s minutes
talent.imsotalented.block_chance.desc: A chance to shrug off an attack from a mob or player completely, even without a shield.
talent.imsotalented.water_breathing.desc: Hold your breath longer underwater, like the Respiration enchantment. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.night_vision.desc: See in the dark while it's toggled on. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.second_wind.desc: Regenerate health while hurt. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.second_wind.effect: Regenerates %s health per second while hurt
talent.imsotalented.step_assist.desc: Walk up full blocks without jumping.
talent.imsotalented.explorer_xp.desc: Earn Explorer XP faster from travelling and finding new places.
talent.imsotalented.safe_falling.desc: Fall further before it hurts, and take less fall damage when it does.
talent.imsotalented.safe_falling.effect: +%s blocks safe fall, %s%% less fall damage
talent.imsotalented.gliding.desc: Fall slowly, like a glider. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
talent.imsotalented.flight_speed.desc: Glide and fly faster. Not in the game yet: buying it does nothing for now.
